title: CYBRIK receipt signature statement v1
description: The exact object that is signed when a Tool Fabric control plane signs an execution receipt. ADR-0004 F8 deferred the receipt-signing envelope (COSE vs. JWS vs. in-toto-style); this schema is one candidate profile offered for that deferred choice and nothing more. The statement never carries the receipt itself, only a digest binding: profile + profile_version fix the digest recipe, canonicalization fixes the byte rendering, receipt_contract_id + receipt_contract_version fix which receipt contract those bytes were produced under, and receipt_id + receipt_digest identify the exact receipt. kid names the signer and resolves only against a pinned external trust bundle. Because the profile id is inside the hash input of receipt_digest, a receipt canonicalized under one profile can never be replayed as if it had been signed under another. Status: PROPOSED — NOT ACCEPTED (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA). No ADR decision, no runtime, no signer and no key lifecycle follow from this file.

profile.description: Receipt digest profile id. The hash input is UTF-8(profile) then one NUL byte then the canonical receipt bytes, so this value is bound into every receipt_digest and cannot be swapped after the fact.

profile_version.description: Version of the profile document, distinct from the profile id itself.

receipt_contract_id.description: $id of the receipt contract the canonical bytes were produced under. Reused unmodified; this proposal changes no byte of it.

receipt_contract_version.description: x-cybrik-contract-version of that receipt contract at signing time.

canonicalization.description: Canonical JSON rendering used before hashing: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme. The exact transmitted receipt is canonicalized with only the top-level receipt_digest and signature removed, and with no schema default materialized — an absent array and an explicitly empty array are two different receipts.

receipt_id.description: receipt_id of the receipt this statement binds.

receipt_digest.description: Digest produced by the profile above over the exact transmitted receipt.

kid.description: Signer key id. Lowercase hex SHA-256 over the RFC 7638 thumbprint input for an OKP key — the JCS rendering of exactly {crv, kty, x}. RFC 7638 renders that digest as base64url; this profile deliberately renders it as hex so the kid grammar stays a single character class. A verifier resolves this id ONLY against a pinned external trust bundle, never against key material carried in the message.

signed_at.description: When the control plane signed. Advisory for ordering only; it is not a validity window and confers no freshness guarantee.
